flights.intro: We recommend you book your flights early to get the best rates. When booking your flight, use the details below for a seamless trip.
flights.airportTitle: O.R. TAMBO International Airport, Johannesburg, South Africa.

travelRequirements.heading: Travel Requirements
travelRequirements.intro: For entry into South Africa, visitors are expected to have the following:
requirements: An international passport with 6 months validity and at least two blank pages.
Sufficient funds to pay for your day-to-day expenses during your stay.
Yellow fever certificates if your journey starts or entails passing through the yellow fever belt of Africa or South America.
travelRequirements.visaExemptionsText: Passport holders from the following countries: US, UK, Ghana, Kenya, Jordan DO NOT require a visa to enter South Africa.
travelRequirements.visaExemptionsLink: Full list of VISA exempt countries/passports
travelRequirements.visaRequirementsIntro: Please apply for your visa now as processing times may vary. We recommend you check your local South African Embassy or Consulate website for timelines and additional information.
travelRequirements.visaRequirementsText: Passport holders from Nigeria, Egypt, Ivory Coast, Senegal and Sudan countries DO require a visa to enter.
travelRequirements.visaRequirementsDetail: Click on the link below for more details on the documents required to apply for a visa and the link to the e-visa application process.
travelRequirements.visaApplicationLink: Details on requirements for visa application

weather.heading: Weather
weather.description1: The weather in South Africa in November sees a wide range of temperatures across the vast and varied landscape, transitioning into the warm early summer months. On average, the high temperatures range from 25°C to 30°C (77°F-86°F), with minimums dropping to 15°C-20°C (59°F-68°F) in the evening.
weather.description2: This range indicates a warm climate throughout the country during this time.

whatToPack.heading: What to Pack
whatToPack.description1: The weather in Johannesburg is getting warmer at this time of the year, please pack business casual outfits with breathable fabrics during the day.
whatToPack.description2: Although the weather is warm during the day, it can get chilly at night. It is advisable to pack layers; a light jacket, sweaters and clothes with warmer materials in order to stay comfortable and warm.
